text: Good vn sandwiches, drinks, snack, everything vietnamese.  Feel like everything back home. We bring back lots of bags back to nj. Always have to come here, small place but tgey have a huuge variety of thing, and made fresh.

My only experience with Malt and Mortar was for drinks one evening. We did not eat so I cannot comment on the food. If I do eat there I will update this review accordingly. We stopped in for drinks after dinner. The server was reasonably attentive and friendly, no complaints there. One person in our group ordered a margarita, which is on the menu. The rest of the group got their drinks within a reasonable amount of tune except for the person that ordered the Margarita. After about 5 minutes, I went to check on the progress and was told that the machine was not working well and needed to warm up. I then realized that the margaritas come out of a Bellini-type of machine. Normally this would not be on my radar because I don't normally order frozen drinks. But as a bartender from way back, I need to make this comment: you cannot, as a reputable bar, rely solely on a Bellini machine as the only source to make margaritas. Get a blender and make it happen. There is a skill in bar tending and it seems to be lost on "kids these days".

Initially they told my mom she couldn't have reservation, and the manager tried to explain something about reservation is a max of ppl and something like that. Anyway we waited 30 mins and got seated & quickly our orders were took. The lady came back with our water which I thought it was nice that it was something we could pour on our own. Also we got "fresh orange juice" it was obviously from concentrate. I ordered the impossible meatballs which is vegan so I thought that was cool. My mom ordered the chicken and waffles & I ordered the lemon ricotta pancakes. My mom says, "the presentation was good but, the serving was too big. It was actually good.. just too big for me." My lemon riccota pancakes... the presentation was alright it kinda looked slapped on but maybe that's the look they were going for... it tasted pretty good. There was 3 pancakes... I could barely finish one. You kind of have to take the toppings off of the first pancake in order to spread the lemon and ricotta and the butter on the other pancakes. Other then that for some reason it was good in the beginning and then I got sick of it. They said the potato fingerlings are potato wedges but, it kinda looks like they just threw some small potatoes into a pot and called it something fancier then a imaginary potato wedge when it's actually just a potato. The pizza was good! Nothing to complain about that. My 2 year old brother enjoyed the pizza. Also I'm not sure if this place had high chairs but, we didn't get o

for a business that's supposed to embrace and celebrate women, i'm pretty disappointed that 2 male employees were gossiping about a group of trans women walking on the sidewalk across the street. then one of the male employees proceeds to thank me for "being a real woman," as if I would agree with his transphobic statements.

get real, i'm just trying to deliver some pizza, mind your business and do your job.

I'm from Seattle so I know seafood.  This place, suggested by someone online, is overpriced and honestly, the fish simply isn't fresh.  Maybe that's too hard for seafood restaurant in the desert.   My husband feels the same way.  He had the Grilled Seabass which was very overcooked.  The drinks were okay though, and the bathrooms are clean, which accounts for the one star.  Otherwise, I must say, avoid this overpriced tourist trap.

So my original review gave Tosco's 5 stars however, within the past year the service has been hit or miss. I'm constantly calling once I get home because the employees failed to prepare my meals correctly. This recent visit, I got home to find a latex glove embedded in my salad. My daughter said what's this mommy and I was confused as to why a glove would be in my salad. And why the employee with the missing glove wouldn't of realized this. I'm absolutely disgusted. I'm rating this establishment two stars because the food is good but inconsistent. I'll have to look elsewhere for good consistent pasta dishes.

Super Impressed so far!! DISCLAIMER: I have only tried the burger and disco fries but they are amazing. I am from New York and believe me when I say there is no where I have found anywhere in Florida that does NY style Diner Food that is until I tried this place through Uber Eats. Very excited to try more items off their menu

Family and Friend Favorite! Fresh Delicious Vietnamese food along with an exceptionally organized staff especially when Dr.Tom the owner is around. Its run like a well oiled machine. Its my favorite Vietnamese restaurant in Tampa and we go almost twice a week and drive 45 min to get there from our home. There is a bakery and refrigerator full of take home goodies as well.

For $4.50 regular 3 topping milk tea it's a good deal. Got the classic with regular sweetness, lychee popping boba, tapioca and rainbow jelly. 

We also got the Thai tea, not too sweet per our liking.

My son is 2 and it's not too sweet for him to enjoy milk tea as well. 


Fun to customize your own drink. The mobile app is easy to use and convenient for curbside pickup. 

Definitely stop by to support your local business.
Everything is great as always.  Special thanks to Erick for his wonderful recommendations.

OH MY GOD ... BEST IN THE CITY ... Awesome

Had a foodie list of places to try when visiting the city. We enter our uber and are turned around looking for this place. Area a little rough around the edges and when you see the crates you have no idea you are in the right spot til you see people walking out with bags of food. 

Thankful for the small seating area. While my friends wanted to grab an order of everything I took a seat and fell knee deep in my food. The fries alone started this fanatic foundation of good food to come.

It's the time of place you want to keep to yourself. i almost didn't want to write a review because I don't want anyone tell me to grab them some food when I go for myself. Really it's that good, especially the creole rub or the honey hot bbq. 

Good Service Great Food

We have always loved coming to this BEER AND WINE GARDEN though during covid we haven't been out much so today was the first time being there since early 2020. NOTE*** this is no longer a beer and wine garden but a restaurant as the owner was very clear to point out.  We were used to the bar setup with a food truck serving food, and when we saw there was no food truck, we grabbed nico's from across the street to go with our beer. The owner came over when he saw we had brought in food to let us know that we can't do that anymore. At least that's how it started. Then he kept going chastising us for bringing in food because he "has a restaurant and you wouldn't do that at El Charro, would you". Overall he treated us like we were just trying to take advantage of him and greatly disrespected him personally. I mentioned that we didn't know they had a kitchen when we arrived and that they used to have food trucks and promote bringing in outside food so we were going off of what we knew prior.  He was very disrespectful and belligerent even though we just apologized, packed up our food, and tried to explain our ignorance. He very effectively and efficiently lost us as customers. We will not be going back, and that's a bummer because EVERYONE ELSE on staff that we've ever interacted with there has been so personable and helpful, and even though the beer selection isn't great and is overpriced, they kept us coming back, but the owner singlehandedly has turned us away for good.
Very nice, authentic English food, nice atmosphere and friendly service. Had the Scotch eggs, shepherds pie and apple crumble, everything was delicious
There is no place like this in Lansdale or around. A beautiful coffee place, where you can sit and enjoy the afternoon :)

Totally grateful for Jack's Firehouse for taking a party of 8 last minute during brunch hours on a Saturday. Went here after completing the half marathon and I was starving!

HIGHLY recommend the lobster Mac & cheese. They don't skimp out in the lobster and it was just simply delicious. Good enough portion too. I also really enjoyed the crab Benedict ! Very satisfying choice as well. I don't recommend the steak and eggs. It was just lacking in taste for me. I ordered a mimosa. Let me tell you - bartender didn't make it primarily orange juice lol. If you like it strong, you came to the right place. I personally didn't like it that strong so I had to add more orange juice to mine.

Service was great. Got all our orders correct and in a timely manner. My friend requested to have her cocktail made differently and the bartender was able to accommodate. Bathrooms were clean but not fond of the wooden doors stalls with the hook. (I know, I'm weird for commenting on the bathroom but this is important to me! Haha)

I would come back to Jack's if I'm in Fairmount again. And you'll definitely find me ordering the lobster Mac & cheese again !

On 3/28: From inside the store, we listened to the employees were loudly bad mouthing customers  who were calling in orders, and making smart ass comments to each other about "stupid" things the customers were asking them over the phone. One employee who looked stoned had his pants hanging down and his ass crack visible. The same employee wasn't using gloves to make the pizza, which they should be doing regardless of the CoronaVirus. The employees weren't washing their hands as the went from handling the phones, touching the register, then going back to making food. Not only will I not order from here again unless things change, I'll be reporting these guys to the Pima County Health Department on Monday. Seriously disgusting.
The owner should retrain or leister fire the 3 guys working Saturday, 3/28.

Surprisingly, my biggest two critiques are the two simplest for a Poke shop. First, the rice (of all things) was somewhat hard, which is unfortunate as that is serves as a base to go with the rice; second, Poke is naturally presented in a beautiful manner, but unfortunately, they somehow made it less than desirable...

However, the fish itself is fresh enough and flavorful (though, more on the spicy side) and there is a wide variety of toppings making a very flavorful bowl overall. 

Additionally, I would recommend signing up for their free rewards program because you get a free soda (and frequent offers for free sodas) and their soda is BOMB--their orange hibiscus is light, yet really flavorful and complex!!
So very friendly and the food is delicious! Recommend the ribeye as well as a cannoli for dessert

OMG, Rustica was truly spectacular. 5/5 For atmosphere. I have tried few things off their menu, I really loved all of them, especially Chicken Cheesesteak was my favorite. The team is very pleasant too. Delightful.

Fantastic experience from the moment we walked into this quaint restaurant tucked in the lovely Pass a Grill neighborhood.  Elevated America fare with an emphasis on fresh seafood, house made pasta and vegetables. My vegan friend loved her squash dish. The shrimp pasta was amazing as was the encrusted grouper. Fantastic wine list and fun cocktails all named after neighborhood dogs. Very friendly service and I felt very safe with the spaced out tables. Will definitely go back when I am back in the area.

Good food and generous portions! Our party had meatballs, ravioli, and an order of their cavateli pasta. Meatballs were great, ravioli were good and actually came with side salads and bread. The bread was phenomenal, salads were good quality, and ravioli was good. Nothing too fancy and probably could have had some added seasoning to boost flavor. Didn't have the pasta myself but was told it was good. 

Would return, especially to try their pizza.

This place is fantastic! Friendly service, and food is very tasty and authentic. Had the pad Thai and the yellow curry were awesome. My kids and husband loved the orange chicken. If you're in the area, we recommend checking this place out.
Don't order the chicken fried steak. Chopped up meat instead of thin sliced beef. Very disappointed

Food was good, nice outdoor sitting, 
Friendly waitress, will definitely go back.
Clean place, ordered house burger, food was cooked like ordered

I never leave bad reviews but this one is well deserved. We stopped by on a Friday night around 7pm for dinner and drinks. When we sat down, we weren't acknowledged or served. No one asked if we wanted drinks or even came up to our table in general. After nearly 30 minutes, we finally flagged down a waitress who said that the restaurant was so busy that they weren't serving food. I have never been to a restaurant that wasn't able to to provide food. The waitress, not even offering us a beverage menu, was so dismissive and rude. She told us to "try again on another night". 

Needless to say, this isn't worth your time to visit.

I had not eaten all day and it was 8 o'clock at night. How disappointing when you're starving. The broccoli beef had no flavor and the broccoli was Brown. This sweet hot chicken was dry and hard. The mein after being soaked with soy sauce was OK. Very disappointing for $12

This pizza reminded me of the old school Godfathers pizza from back in the 80's . And I think I'm in love again (LOL)!!  So, if you know what I mean from back in the day in Indianapolis you'd know and love this pizza too!!!

The atmosphere is nice. The service is horrible. Don't know if it is lack of staff or what. But everything takes forever. Management walks around like nothing is wrong and are oblivious to how shitty service is. Expect to be there for 3 hours if eating.

Tonight my husband and I visited this Grillsmith for a date night out and were served by an AMAZING SERVER named JEFF he was absolutely wonderful, very charismatic, extremely knowledgeable and we didn't have to wait long for anything. The food is always amazing but the service tonight spoke for itself JEFF was phenomenal! Thanks again! And Happy Holidays! :)
UPDATE! They are open again for on-site consumption and following all socially distant protocols! Went there last weekend and had a great time - also check out the new food selections by Side Piece!!
Super tasty! Their Mac and cheese is delicious, their pulled pork is super tasty too. I love their tangy sauce. :) def worth stopping in. The owner is super nice too! Pleasant experience.

Can't go wrong here.  Great menu selection, every entree that we enjoyed was outstanding and prepared perfectly.  Especially the house made pastas.  Drink menu was on par with food, prices were fair and the atmosphere is busy, fun and comfortable.   One of the most beautiful restaurants that I've ever visited from coast to coast.  Definitely a must visit for a foodie if you're in the area or within a short drive of this destination eatery!

Flatbread pizza at its finest! I was pretty excited when this location opened due to it being near my gig. I gave it a try and decided to share pizza and salad..Great idea because the portion size is pretty big. This visit I ordered just pizza and to my surprise they have vegan cheese which was delish!!! Even had the option of getting zucchini on my order. The dining area isn't huge but just enough space for several small tables.

My boyfriend and I ordered in a simple order, 10 boneless wings with sauce on the side and some fries. We ordered takeout and when my boyfriend got home we realized we didn't have our sauce, which is kinda the whole point of going to BWW. Well I called because I just wanted a refund and who I'm assuming is the manager said if we wanted to come back up he would remake our entire meal fresh. So my boyfriend went back and got our entire meal remade with some added chips and salsa. Really great customer service!!

Vegans, rejoice! Comfort food is hereeee! I've loved everything I've gotten here. My go to right now is the T.L.T sandwich and the Brussels. The TLT is a lighter feeling option but still delicious. Sometimes the Brussels are a little too oily but overall I always enjoy the crispness!

Great tacos full of flavors and nice fresh salsa, queso and guacamole. We got the spare ribs, fried shrimp, fried fish, and carne asada tacos. They were amazing and the drinks for happy hour were on point. Definitely worth a try. All servers were abiding with the masks rules and they were sanitizing down every table as guests were finished.

Stayed here Sunday -Monday night. Hotel room was clean and felt safe in parking lot and surrounding area. Super pet friendly! I didn't bring my fur kids but thought about it for next time. Loved the outdoor pool bar area. Wish we had more time to enjoy. The bartender was in her bikini- so cute! Cleaning crew everywhere due to COVID. Sushi bar and Buffet closed down due to Covid. Unfortunate, because it was not mentioned on their website or when we checked in. My husband was looking forward to sushi! Next time...! We did enjoy dinner at the noodle bar and everything was HOT and Fresh! So good. Drinks were over priced but it is a casino. Loved all the decor of the hotel. Staff was friendly. We will be back. Minimum for tables was $25 for the most part.
Messy & Oh So DeLish! Cooked so perfectly, no tools needed and all meat easily released in full lump - Definite to repeat!

I had brunch her with my family & we had a great time! They had lots of comfortable outdoor seating & they took all of the COVID precautions (social distancing, masks, cleaning, etc.). 10/10 recommend the fried chicken eggs Benedict!
I am sure to make a visit here when I am in New Orleans.    Some of the best Mexican food I have ever had!
Food was really disappointing. I ordered the crab cakes and they were filled with shells and coated in an overly sweet mayonnaise sauce. I can't recommend this place.

To cope with the Covid-19 lock down, Mimi Blue has started offering a family meal for carryout. We ordered it one Saturday to have a special evening. As we've come to expect from Mimi Blue, everything was freshly prepared in-house and delicious: 8 large meatballs (we chose beef but veggie is also available), linguine with chunky, tomato-y marinara, baby lettuce salad and freshly baked ciabatta bread. It's a great deal for $26. Everything tasted great! The linguini and meatballs were packed in a double pan, which kept them warm until we got home. We will definitely order again. My only quibble was that we could have used more marinara. Next time, we'll order extra.

On my last take-out visit to M&J's I ordered the taco salad with black bean crumble. It was very good, and I would order it again! Good flavor, light but still filling, and fresh! The salad does come with a lot of cheese - I ordered it without and they did accidentally put it on (not a huge deal). The service was great and the order was timely! A great place to get take-out!
Really good intestines and other sichuan dishes. Love it...I wish I had friends who like to eat spicy as much as I do then I would get to come here often but for now I get to enjoy it myself.

Had so much fun participating in #YelpsBigNightIn tonight while supporting a local restaurant! I surprised the hubby with a fun, yet romantic setup on our deck and we sat outside for a couple hours just enjoying each other's company and Jamaican food! 

We ordered from Da Blue Lagoon and it was AMAZING! I had the Island Trio which had jerk chicken, coconut-curry chicken and fricasseed chicken it was served with rice and beans and choice of 1 side. I got the soca Mac n cheese . 

I definitely recommend you check them out! There's a location in Lawrence and you can catch their food truck around during the summer! The food had SO much flavor and had the perfect amount of heat but not fire. Hubby and I can't wait to order from there again!

Finally tried tried this place and was not disappointed. I went on Tuesday when the tacos are $2 each. I got one of each - cauliflower, chicken, V-Spot (beef) and oyster tacos. I'm not sure how they do it, but the texture and flavor on all these meatless tacos were so accurate! The cauliflower and oyster ones were my favorite, but they all have a great flavor and even a little spicy kick to the sauce. I'll definitely be returning because there's so many other things on this menu that I want to try. Make sure you wear your mask to enter.

This restaurant needs to update their menu. I went into the restaurant to place a to-go order and I requested the Rasta pasta with salmon. They told me they were out of salmon. Next, I tried ordering the Jamaican styled nachos and they told me they no longer sell them. I finally decided to order two beef patties, a side of cabbage, and a side of Mac and Cheese. 

It took about 30 minutes for me to get my food. To me, that wait was quite lengthy for three side orders. Anyways, the cabbage was pretty tasty but the Mac and cheese was not good at all. My beef patties were cold but they tasted ok. I would return to this restaurant to try the oxtails but other than that I don't see myself ordering from here again.
Amazing ! Try the wings or chicken sandwich! Quick service ! Great food! Friendly staff! Among the best in west Chester! Better in store but delivery is still amazing
My food was awful I'm not sure why people say this place is good. White sandwich bread nothing French at all. We didn't finish our meals and left :(
Do not come here if you're in a rush. I was in drive thru from 2:04 until 2:36. & this happens every time I come to this location. Order was accurate and nice customer service.

I've been going to Picas since I moved to the area is 2005 as my husband loves the pizza. After tonight's dinner, unfortunately I'm not sure we will be going back. The bread seemed as if someone gutted it and then served it - it was basically crust and the pizza (half pepperoni, half meatball) was extremely disappointing. The pizza was slightly burned on the bottom yet came out luke warm and had little to no flavor. They have sprinkle garlic on the table which had the same size holes as crushed red pepper so when you pour it on the pizza be careful or you'll have a pile of garlic. At 7:15 we felt rushed to leave the restaurant despite them closing at 9pm. Really disappointing Picas experience.

Their food is good and convenient for where we live, but we continue to have issues when we order carry out. They don't give appropriate wait times, so take your time if they tell you 15 mins- ends up being closer to 30

Was here Saturday for dinner. My date and I started with arrancina balls which were recommended by Don the owner. To say that they were to die for would be the understatement of the year. I had the same things week earlier at the grand Café Aquila as 17th and Chestnut in Philadelphia.  Not only were Scalessa's a million times better but I got twice the amount for half the price. I then got the 'Chicken Scalessa' which was top with bubbling crab with a blush sauce. She had the veal Parm with fresh provolone and oregano. We both had a side of their homemade gnocchi. The only thing that could've made this meal any better would have been if I could've brought my mom and had a glass of wine to Don his darling daughters and the rest of the staff thank you so much. Bravo !!!!  Even though I live in Pennsylvania you will absolutely be seeing a lot of me. Anyone reading this review trust me when I tell you you will not be disappointed I guarantee it. I'm sorry I can only give you five stars!!!!!
Best restaurant around.. lobster tail n sirloin combo was the best. Im not a big mac n cheese fan but here, loved it..

Well, this Texan/Okie loves BBQ and smoked meats. Since coming to the STL area, I've eaten at the best points in town and across the big river, too. Too many to mention! I hear thru my son in law Jason, that the Pork Steak was a local specialty. Of course I snickered! 
Well today I ate the absolutely best pork steak of my 70 yr old life. Tender, juicy, smoky and packed with flavor! Only shared a half order with Jason and quickly realized that was a mistake. 
OMGosh, can't wait to go back and try the ribs!!
Brisket and Brussels Sprouts were very tasty, too!!!
We love El Fuego! The food and staff are great!! Be sure and try Burritos East and the fajitas. The guacamole is a fave too!
Cane here for drinks. The jalapeño pineapple margarita was amazing. Great atmosphere. And great service.

I'd give 3.5 if I could. 

We came here for Mother's Day and were very pleasantly surprised to see they had a brunch menu! The prices weren't listed which was odd but the waiter told us the price of everything which was great. 

The coffee was ok. We got the chicken and waffles with hot honey, bacon chive and cheddar omelette & steak fries and Brussel sprouts to split. We ordered the sides because when we asked our waiter if our food came with any he said no. We were surprised when the omelette came out with hash browns and fruit. I personally liked the food, my boyfriend said he didn't think it was worth the price which was around 20-25 for each item. Brussels were 9. 

Our server was very kind and helpful. Great energy. 

The atmosphere in the restaurant was very dark!!!!! We could barely see anything!!!!! 

Probably wouldn't come back here but it's an option when you can't find anything else. Definitely not worth the price.

Split the 12 oz parmesan crusted chicken tonight and choose the asparagus as our side, so moist and delicious. Paired with an appetizer and a couple side salads it's more than enough food!  BTW, Don't be afraid to try the blue cheese dressing it's awesome.

Probably my favorite restaurant I experienced during my trip to New Orleans and would recommend to anyone traveling here! Everything from the drinks, classic creole food, and the pecan pie was phenomenal. The best part was the service. My friend and I came in around 9 pm and it was still packed. We received A+++ service all around and the waiter we had was very friendly and helpful. I wasn't sure about the restaurants on bourbon street, but this was made any doubts go away.

I have to admit, Pizzeria Stella was truly astonishing. This place is great at what it does. These guys are certainly serving yum at his location. Very friendly, attentive and knowledgeable. Can not wait to visit Pizzeria Stella again!
Every food we ordered was tasty, flavorful and fresh including the tuna pokè and 1 more not pictured was the calamari.  Perfect portion for my husband and myself!

OK, so every Ford's Garage I've ever been to has had only mediocre service and food....until this visit to this location.....I knew there had to be a diamond in the rough somewhere! :)

Came here to try their burgers since haven't been to this location yet.  We were welcomed and seated very quickly for a Friday evening around 6PM.  Corner booth which was also very nice.  Greeted by the server right when we sat and he took our drink orders.  We also placed an app order for wings.  I didn't know this, however their wings are not breaded despite the description making it appear that they were.  And let's not forget to mention that they were pretty darn tasty!  My hubs and I both ordered the Low Carburetor which is for individuals on low carb diets as it's not served on a bun.  I opted for cheese on mine for an extra charge.  I got fries as my side and gave to my daughter who also ordered the mac and cheese (that she devoured btw) and my hubs got the side salad for us to share.  Overall, dinner was very good and if we do want Ford's again, we are definitely coming to this location.
Great spot for some drinks. Don't waste your money on the food. Not good at all. The entertainment is also wack. But good cheap drinks and  at an awesome location.

This place was so good!!! I got the chicken tender skillet.
AMAZING!!! Worth every penny!

I can usually find at least one good thing to say about a restaurant, but that is not the case here. We ordered drinks and our dinner, and the drinks came out pretty quickly. It was the saltiest margarita I have ever tasted, but I was hopeful the entrée would be better. After waiting approximately 90 minutes for the fried trio, I was nothing short of completely disappointed. The fried scallops were rubbery and gamey, the fish was soggy and fell apart, and the fried shrimp were on par with a fast food chain. Actually, I have had better fried shrimp at the Popeyes drive-through.

Our waiter disappeared for the better part of 45 minutes, but in the two hours we spent here, he did manage to forget to bring me a water at least three times. So I guess that's something?

Not recommended. For anything. Ever.

This is one of the better middle eastern markets in town in terms of variety, it's a grocery store and it has a little restaurant inside. BUT, most things are extremely overpriced and although they are authentic they are not that great of quality. I go here often only because they are close to me and the next best M.E. grocery store is in Phoenix. They do have "rewards", like if you spend $50 you get $5 at the little restaurant BUT you have to mention it because if you don't bring it up they won't give it to you. You won't be able to get anything with $5 anyway because all the food is priced over $6. I often get the Iraqui bread because they make it there, but I can never find it fresh. If you want to find anything in the tiny store no one knows where it is, all the employees are a little bit disorganized and will direct you to another employee which will then direct you to another employee. If you don't speak Arabic it will be even harder to get what you want. I do want to mention that the food at the restaurant is good. They have excellent and very nice cooks that make authentic tasting middle eastern food.

The french toast sandwich for breakfast was fantastic!  Quick and heidi service staff.  

It looked so good, I forgot to take a photo.  I dove right in.
Just stopped in for opening day lunch. Food is fresh and menu is great. Spicy Tuns bowl was great!
Always spot on for a perfect meal both before the pandemic and always has the best take out during this crap we're dealing with! Top notch menu... Will return time and time again!
Great food and great beers! The beer menu is always rotating and gives plenty of options for any type of beer drinker.
I love the egg salad sandwich for lunch. If you go for breakfast try the shrimp and cheese grits. They are delicious!

wow almost 11 years living in Tampa and today was my very first time dining at brio. The many times I have walked last brio I always wondered if I'd ever have an opportunity to eat here.. today was the day! Came for the lunch special $12 for a soup or salad and bolognese pasta! Of course I had to sit out site to enjoy people watching and their patio set up is cute. The service was a bit slow but it was very busy. Our server was friendly! My salad was delicious and pasta was too. Everything was hot and full of flavor. Bread was steaming hot & fresh. Enjoyed this place! Would come back for the steak salad!
First time in Nashville...great little bar off of Broadway....artists playing original songs. Refreshing from the loud bars on Broadway playing covers. Laurie was a great single handed bartender!

We ordered take out today.  I got the veggie benedict and my boyfriend got Portuguese sausage and scrambled eggs.  The food was tasty.  

My only problem is the Styrofoam packaging.  We all know how bad it is for our planet.  Im not sure why it is still sold.  Planet friendlier disposables are more expensive I know, so offset the cost and charge a surcharge for togos.

I would not have a problem paying a couple of bucks more for take out.

SHOW MOTHER NATURE SOME KINDNESS AND STOP USING STYROFOAM!!!!
Best seafood hands down.  I've eaten at a lot of places even the shore but they can't compare. Prices and service are great

My boyfriend and I went here for our anniversary and loved it. I definitely recommend making a reservation, we made one but still had to wait about 20 minutes to be seated. While you are waiting you can go get a drink at their bar. I really liked their Chardonnay. They are also very willing to make specialty drinks. Once we got seated our server was very attentive and helpful. She recommended some delicious meals. I had the lobster raviolis and they were fantastic, my boyfriend had their chicken Parmesan and say it was great as well. It is an expensive date but worth the all the money. Will be going back very soon!

I pulled up to the drive thru at 8:20 pm on Sat. 1/30/2021 and the greeting was we close in 20 minutes so we are not taking anymore orders. SO, if they close at 9:00 maybe there clocks are 20 minutes fast. Drove down to Rally's and ate better and cheaper.  I told lady taking my order at Rally's about it and she was not surprised at all.  How can an owner let their employees turn away business like that? Every review I see of that place is horrible! Their site says they are open 24 hrs. I understand  with Covid-19 and crime they alter hours but not have time to fry a hamburger with at least 40 minutes left is absolutely ridiculous!
         Signed LOST CUSTOMER FOREVER

I was thinking about 4 but am putting 5. Overall the fish seems fresh, pretty good selection, and definitely welcome in this sushi desert of the Philly burbs. Look, Ambler is not LA or NY so a restaurant like this is almost community service. Having only tried the moriawase (nigiri / roll set) and a few other rolls can say I'll definitely be back. However I have to mention the rice was hard and didn't seem "fresh," which was disappointing for a sushi joint. Also the roll pieces were not all cut to the same size but that's what happens when you are ordering at 6pm on Friday. Lastly wow we are missing out on BYOB, but hope to do that in the future. 

PS open only Thu, Fri, and Sat for takeout during COVID

This is still my favorite watering hole in the garden district. NOLE is a southern-mexican fusion place with some real unique flavors and good drinks. 

If you want to best bartender in NOLA, go see Will. AKA Willie. The Don of the House Margarita and he will take the best care of you with nothing but that top shelf service and quality. The best of the best.

Delicious small plates, great drinks, and an awesome staff. Check these guys out soon!

Every time I come here I am kindly greeted by the friendly staff. They are a true family owned business that practices such excellent customer service it becomes a joy to purchase food from them. I have always been so happy with the freshness of the food. I order the #101. beef shawarma. Delicious!! 
They are worth the drive I make to eat there. The prices are very reasonable as well! 
So grateful for this restaurant.
Always a treat to dine here or order for takeout. The food is fabulous and the staff is always friendly. Service with a smile, if you can envision through the masks.

I've been to Acropolis so many times, I've lost count. I had this long review in my draft with all the food that I ate. Which was all delicious by the way! I talked about the festive and inviting ambience. I went on and on about the attentiveness, professionalism, and friendliness of each and every server. I talked about the staff dancing around and breaking the plates all over the floor.  I mentioned the professional,  belly dancer that coaxed some of us to get out of our seats and shimmy our money makers.  I even talked about the unisex bathroom that is usually very clean. Well,  I go back to finish the review and it's gone! I freakin' refuse to write the review all over again Dog gone it! I'm just not going to do it! ;-)
Paris culinary experience on Main Line. Bring your favorite vino and enjoy authentic French Cuisine. Delicious!

Sunday lunch. Yes a reservation would be the best idea. We was told about 45 minutes, got called about 20 mins. We ordered came not too long but we never got our Tapas, had to asked about it, waiter went to get, very Hot but the mushroom not tasty. Sea Bass meal very tasty & pork meal good. Dessert Flan oh my yummy. Waiter very friendly and attentive even if busy.

Absolutely the best pizza in the city. It's old school and classic. The service is outstanding and food is always fresh.  The location is perfect right near all the sporting events. Must try the pizzaz pizza there is no one that makes it better.

First time ordering Chinese here in Tampa. A bit surprised by the previous reviews. This place is basic - if you want Chinese food just to check it off your crave list this isn't the worst place. The Crab Rangoon was loaded with cream cheese and did have decent flavor to them. The egg roll was terrible and I do not recommend you feeding it to any one. The chicken and broccoli was good not too salty like you find in most places. The sesame chicken was also pretty good but their pork fried rice was amateur hour. Fried rice usually has some sort of veggies or green onions or something. This was completely simple. Almost like brown rice and pork bits. Yikes!!  Over all middle of the road place but I'd go back if I really wanted Chinese and no other place was available. Advice is work on the small details adding a few extras to rice or better egg rolls would have earned 4 stars.
Not enough seating. Small portions for amount paid. Poor customer service. Tastes nothing like DTF. Save your money

We visited recently and it ended in my husband spending over 6 hours in the emergency room. My husband was simply trying to move the long bench on wheels out from underneath the table. The bench then fell on his foot, causing it to immediately start bleeding. The staff was beyond rude, one did offer a first aid kit but he never returned. The manager on duty only wanted to know if we were going to sue them. We tried to quickly eat so we could get my husband to the hospital. After the 6 hours in the ER my husband has not 1 but 3 broken toes. We are waiting to hear if he needs surgery on one of them. I wrote Serial Grillers through their contact form and honestly was not impressed with their response. We likely will never return.

SO amazing!! Decided to go on a whim and was so happy! SUCH YUMMY FOOD! Bobby the manager was so helpful when we asked what he recommended. He pointed us to the dry rub wings with Glory Day's special sauce & it was the best decision I ever made. I wish I took pictures. Great atmosphere, great place to watch some sports games!

First time here... Very good meal. Fresh ingredients, well prepared. Good service. Well designed, open, modern room. We'll certainly be back. Two minor complaints. 1. As with most modern restaurants the room does not have proper acoustic treatment and became unbearably loud when the space filled up. 2. There was a family eating that thought it was ok for their daughter to watch Dora the Explorer on her phone without headphones and at full volume. Can't blame the restaurant for rude people and following design trends.

Generous portions of plant based goodness. Both my husband and I enjoyed the food here and ate on the patio. I had the tamale filled with veggies and potatoes. Very tasty.  My husband had the burger. A little messy but tastes great.
Excellent food and right downtown is a plus. My wife and I enjoyed our meal before heading to a concert at Enterprise Center . Service is good and we will be coming back
Great food, super friendly staff, ordering and phone service with Covid is a little hard to get through. But, overall really good burgers !!
Pizza was great but not what I expected from the hype. What was off the charts was the service!! Nice job Cristinos!

Take out is available during Covid. I wanted to try multiple items and decided to give this place 3 stars. Some items on the menu are really good and some items I wouldn't order again. 
The hot and sour soup had too much vinegar in it. 
The pickled chicken feet left me super thirsty, and it was a bit slimy. I have had this at other restaurants and it's not supposed to be slimy. The beef chow fun was okay. I have had better and I have had worse.  The scallion pancake had good flavor, but it was a little soggy. Since it was take out, then it wasn't freshly eaten when cooked so that is just the covid environment of take out.  The beef tendon chili sauce dish was super good. 
I would like to go back and try the other items as certain things were really well done. 
Service was friendly and quick. The order was ready in 15 minutes.
I love the hard rock, but this place is a delight that surprised me.   Miss the slot machines but the food and service just as great as any of their casinos

Lovely spot to eat a beignet and get anything else. The line to order will take a while but you get 3 beignets for $3.99. 

The amount of sugar you get on each is perfect, and this is a great dessert or snack to split with someone else!

I'm going to give them a second chance and amend my review accordingly. 

The appetizers (scallop ceviche, oysters on the half shell, bocaditos) were exceptional. The crispy bacon bocaditos are a hit and superbly prepared. 

My husband very much enjoyed his drinks and dinner (enchiladas banderas loaded with fresh seafood).  

My initial attempt at halibut was a terrible disappointment: over-cooked and flavorless. To be fair, our server (who doubled as the bartender) promptly fixed the issue. Apparently, all of the halibut was sitting in water in the kitchen (waterlogged fish steams instead of searing, thus turning it to rubber). I was sad for the waste of such an incredible fish. The server recommended the branzino Veracruz served in a tomato, olive, and caper sauce. The branzino was drowning in a pool of a bold sauce. I liked the branzino. I liked the sauce. The sauce overwhelmed the branzino. The gist: I did not think the sauce did any service to the fillet of branzino. 

The bread pudding and coconut tres leches desserts were amazing. Highly recommended!

Ambience and service were both great. Again, I look forward to returning and trying it out again for an improved rating... it looks like it has the potential.

I went a few months back and it was sooo crowded, we finally were sat at a tiny table back near the kitchen right next to three giant parties. I think it was the loudest dining experience ever, I couldn't hear my bf across the little table. However, we are suckers for large margaritas and Mexican food so we still had an enjoyable time. I loved my coronarita and the Spanish rice that came with my dinner was delicious

Great food combined with friendly people. Attentive to your needs. Don't let the outside keep you from stepping in! Fun eccentric interior.

Definitely would come again.
Awesome pizza! This is the perfect place to go when you are touring the World War II museum. At the museum for a couple of hours get lunch here and then just go back only a block away!

I love Whataburger but on Friday evening we were in line in drive thru.its was packed and they. Were moving the line fast . We order 2-1s
Combos And a Xtra side of onion rings. Employees were great,but when we got home our burgers and fries were cold like they had been sitting there for over an hour or two it was very disappointing . We passed several of the competition to get to your location but at the next time more than likely we will not return for a while since there is a lot of ongoing issues in this world right now and I know that this is not a huge issue compared to everything else we face. I was just wanted to inform leadership of what is happening at this location.
Loved everything about the place! Ambiance, food, wine list, service were all on point. I think this is my new favorite place in East Nashville. Can't wait to go back!

Whats the saying ?

You never know until you know ? 
I dont know how it goes , buuut now i know to not eat here again or give someone a gift card to this place.. 

First and last visit sadly because i love steve erwin and kangaroos but i cannot waste my money on a place like this... 


Best thing i have to say is the hostess did a great job trying to offer us a table and not a booth because of my rucas belly due to there being a bun in the oven..
&&& their pepper is really good....

Waited a while to order , 

My onion blossom was horrible.  I think the fryer oil was old or something not sure but the batter was awful

My side salad dressing was not the best . It was a ceaser and just didnt have good flavor .. croutons were good tho..

My burger came out with blood in the bread all pink and turn offish , i love my meat pink but this was bleeding and begging for me to not eat it . 
The lady was nice about it . Not her fault . 

Im happy yelp rewarded me with the free blossom cause i didnt take two bites of it . 

- yeah pretty bad ... 

Took a while to get my burger my lady got the soup and salad so not sure why it took about half hour .

This is the best biscuit and gravy I have ever eaten! Included a fried egg and bacon. Oh my gawd, where have you been all my life?!?! 

Walked in 5 minutes before closing and they treated me like I was the most important customer of the day. I was taken care of by Dillon and Jaylin (probably butchered your name, sorry brother, you still rock!). These guys helped make my experience even better. No rushing me out the door as they consider the business open as long a a guest is there. These are young guys who care, WooHoo! 

Please come to Colorado, I will be your first customer! Nom Nom!

We went to this place over Chinese New Year as a family. And we were very disappointed. The dishes we ordered were not authentic at all.  Peking duck did not have crispy skin. There were strange combinations of food that were too American. Compared to Chinatown eats it's just not good enough to get a high rating. If you've never grown up eating traditional Chinese then I suppose it wouldn't matter. But for those looking for authentic experiences, this is not the place to go.

My girlfriend and I have been to A La Mousse multiple times and have ordered different things. We haven't been disappointed thusfar. The most recent item we ordered was the Pretty Lady Teapot. Although I am not much of a hot tea person, I thoroughly enjoyed the nearly endless teapot. I would also highly recommend any pastry shown in the pastry shelves that can be viewed by anyone who walks in.

My family has visited this location four times now and we have been given great service and we have been provided with great food. My wife loves the pho and so far my favorite is the bbq pork sandwich. Give them a shot. It's great stuff!

This was both a great meal and a great experience. We showed up on a Friday evening at 7 on with our group of 10.  We were celebrating an impromptu family reunion with four generations. Even though the restaurant was Friday-night busy, they managed to find and set our table quickly. The service was excellent, as was the food. One dish was mis-prepared but the server rushed over before the food had been sampled to tell the diner that the replacement was on its way. She even offered to box up the first dish to take home. 

Poco and Mom's Cantina was the perfect place for our family dinner. We will be back, but in  smaller groups.

Came here during lunch hour on a Friday and place was pretty packed which is a good sign. It didn't take us too long get a seat, which is a seat your self type of place. We were greeted by the manager maybe? He was nice and our server didn't take long to get over to us. My lunch companion ordered the short rib poboy which was recommended by our server. It was an interesting choice because it came with arugula and onion rings along with the short rib. I was hesitant to take a bite of it but do not regret it. It was so good. Maybe my next choice when I return. I had the shrimp poboy which was packed with perfectly fried season shrimp. Bread was soft and not chewy. Service was great and food came out quick. Will be back! Street parking and also front patio seating.

Really good sandwiches. I love the sandwiches here and the online ordering is super convenient. The gluten free bread isn't that great, but the inside of the sandwich is awesome. Really impressed with this place.

This place is the bees knees. It came highly recommended by my parents after a visit to NOLA so we stopped in for dinner one night on our trip. There were 4 of us and we all ordered tacos of all kinds:

Drew Brees (duh, we're Purdue fans...in New Orleans ‍) 10/10
Calypso Beef 10/10
Carolina BBQ 10/10
Jerk Chicken 10/10
Trinidad Chicken 10/10

We weren't sure of some of the tacos and our waitress was able to give detailed descriptions of each one that she was very helpful. Their Rum Punch was great, it was decorated with a bunch of really good fruit too! It's super close to the streetcars which is how we got around the city so it was easy to get to our next destination.

Has the potential to be a great restaurant but not quite there yet. The place is beautifully decorated and we enjoyed our meals. Standouts were the pasta (mushroom, lamb) and antipasto dishes (tuna carpaccio, mackerel). Secondi lamb dish was good but served lukewarm. The staff were friendly but lacked the skills to make this a great restaurant. The antipasti dishes were literally taken away as soon as the last piece of food left the plate. We were looking forward to dipping the beautiful bread in the sauces but were beaten to it. We were about to do this with the pasta dishes but again the server was too eager. The wrong cutlery was placed on the table and we overhead staff members bickering. Nothing that can't be fixed with some training and experience. Will be back and hopefully the teething problems will be long gone.

No wait on December 26 at 930pm. I'll say that giving this restaurant a low rating bc of the wait doesn't make sense. It's popular and doesn't take reservations. My rating is a 3.5 because the women's bathroom is disgusting. I worked in restaurants in my youth and the adage was always check the bathroom before you order food. They have an orderly line to wait for the restroom, but I'm attaching pics of what it looks like on 12/26/19. The beignets and cafe au lait were delicious but I caution future visitors to use the restroom someplace else.
The appetizers were great along with the service. I certainly don't recommend the grilled shrimp and linguine as it is excessively salty. The French onion soup is decent.

I just got out of the hospital from food poisoning after eating at this restaurant.  Never go there again.  I had the chicken and it had to have been bad.

Patty Cummings

Nice atmosphere, in a booth you can hear others in your party. Would have liked a thicker cut of the bone-in ribeye and greater portion of vegetables with the entrees. The scallops were delicious. The brussel sprouts were amazing and had unique flavor with the touch of mint. The seasonal harvest pear cocktail was awesome! Our server, Katie, was prompt, courteous, and had terrific knowledge of cocktails and entrees with good recommendations.  Nice non‐chain restaurant for the area.

I can't believe that somebody would have the nerve to ask me if I wanted my change. The young person has no clue of the value of money and I am amazed the management there has not gotten on to this . Or do they not ask why did the cash drawer had overage?? Typical millennial. Not coming here ever again!!!
Love this place!  Amazing tamales and sides.  Always very friendly staff.  Never disappointed here!

The food was pretty amazing. Since it was all tapas like, we ordered a whole bunch of dishes for 5 of us, and everything was great. The only thing that was meh, was the cheese flatbread: essentially just a regular pizza. 

I assume the menu changes, but this time we had the roasted cauliflower, linguine with clams and crab, cheese pizza, Korean wings, fish dip with crostini. It was all very yummy.

You need to order dessert. We got the salted caramel ice cream with candied bacon in a waffle cone. Bake chocolate chip cookie in a cast iron with scoop of sweet cream ice cream on top. And a tropical sorbet dish (mango sorbet, lime jello and guava sauce)-that was very cleansing. 

There were birthdays all around us, you get a sparkling roman candle and cotton candy. We were tempted to say we had a birthday!

Always so grateful for the customer service and drinks at mojos especially when they're open at a time like this. They set all the chairs aside so the customers would have a clear path to the register and order their drinks. I recommend ordering the "agar boba" as a topping if you're feeling something different or just in general. It's my favorite topping besides boba and mojo gets it right. Can't wait to try their order drinks
Had a Chicken Salad croissant sandwich, Gorgonzola salad and chocolate chip cookie. What a wonderful local joint.  Yummo!
Great food and great service. There was an issue with our order and the manager didn't hesitate to fix it. He even drove the corrected food back to us himself which was totally unexpected. A++

The pierogis here? Delicious. The dill pickle soup here? PHENOMENAL. Those are my 2 favorite things to get, paired with one of their fun polish beers. I've tried other things too which have all been good but I have my favorites. If you haven't been here, give it a try!
One of the best sushi restaurants in Reno/Sparks area!  Their service is quick and the food is delicious! You can't go wrong with anything you u order here.

Delicious tastes and great portions. Unquestionably the best breakfast in town. I've never had such unique tastes in three different breakfast dishes. The endless drip coffee was the best and I'll be coming back again.

Husband picked up lunch today. He called the order in and as he was pulling in they called to let him know it was ready. He said everyone was wearing masks and gave great service. He got me turkey, mashed potatoes with gravy, and mac n cheese. Turkey was great, mashed potatoes were ok, they were homestyle with skin in them, would have been better no skin, mac n cheese was good. He got pulled pork, mac n cheese and mashed potatoes. He loved the pork and mac n cheese. He also was not a fan of the homestyle mashed. Next time different sides. Reasonably priced and it filled us both up.  Good to try something different.

The blueberry pancake was delicious. Unique and memorable. Nothing too impressive about the country fried steak, would definitely try something else next time. Hashbrowns are definitely on point. Great service and hip, clean place!

Marvelous little vegan bakery and cafe on Oak Street. The breads are delicious- we pick up a baguette every once in a while to bring home and occasionally get a second baguette to bring to my parents (since you can never go wrong bringing mom a baguette.)
Our entire family absolutely loves the brioches. (I'm partial to the vanilla-glazed ones and chocolate-covered ones, but they're all delicious!) Service is excellent and quick- and they're good about taking covid precautions by requiring masks and limiting the number of people allowed inside at a time.
If you want to enjoy your food there but are eschewing indoor dining right now, they've got some outdoor tables both out front and in the back courtyard. In the back courtyard, you might also get to hang out with the sweet, adorable kitties who live there. (My son always wants to peek out into the courtyard to see if he spots the cats even when we are just picking up bread to bring home.)

Okay I LOVE this place.

Y'all, my only complaint is the service sucks. I am a server myself, and, this place is severely understaffed. Therefore, you might wait 20 minutes to even be noticed.

But, if boozy slushies are your thing, go here. Sooo many options too drink your face off without even tasting a hint of booze. Great fried chicken sandwiches too, average Mac and cheese. Party environment. You'll get some tourists but not the super annoying ones.

I love Oyster House. I have been here several times and always try to hit up the Saturday Happy Hour when I have guests in town. The Oyster selection is wide and the other food options are also delicious. Highly recommend if you are in center city.

This spot is a local fave of mine! They currently have a great outdoor dining spot on their patio, but I opt for take out mostly. I got the Gnocchi, Arugula salad, and broccoli pizza all to go. All three were still hot and extremely fresh by the time I got home. The gnocchi was so delicious, I wanted more. Next time, I might get two orders of it! The pizza and salad were a great combo. I will order these exact items again as soon as possible.

I love sandwiches and I love ikes. D.U.T.C.H..C.R.U.N.C.H... is why I keep coming back along with all other crazy ass varieties they have.

This location specifically left a huge impression (I'm originally from the bay area) due to the service during covid. I came in with the BF and we had a sandwich voucher. We ended up picking out a sandwich that was over the voucher allowed amount, to which I didn't mind paying. But, the staff was very apologetic and genuinely felt bad that they offered to make up for it. For this, and this alone,  the gesture and acknowledgement for me is what stood out. I live in Spanish Springs and I would gladly drive all the way down to this ike's location for sandwiches to support the awesome staff!

A1 steak sauce/stellar service and of course my love for ikes sandwiches makes this Ike's location 5-Yelp Stars "Great"!
Service was great. The Cesar salads were not great. The sampler plate offered a lot of different options for our large group. I personally liked the fish tacos!

After moving back from Southern California my husband and I have been scouring the St. Louis area for the perfect açaí bowl place. Rush had one person working so service was pretty slow and he had his friends visiting him which slowed down the process even more. The açaí bowl was more like a smoothie with how melted it was and the strawberries that I paid $1 extra for was disappointing. Pretty sure I paid $1 for 1 strawberry....

All in all the "açaí bowl" wasn't bad tasting but as a whole I am not inclined to come back.

Definitely one of my favorite places to eat downtown. Everyone who works there is always so friendly and patient while you create your poke concoctions. The bowls are fresh and plentiful. I often have leftovers for later and the serving bowls make it easy to take the rest to go which is a big plus. Love all the art and theming. It really makes lunch a little getaway.
Just moved from Sf Ca, and this is my new go to for crab, Cajun sauce is tasty, and great with rice.
Had a fantastic dinner with the family. We did the Kamayan and it was the perfect way to enjoy Perla with the child. Warm and welcoming and an intimate space. Would come back!

This is a great local place with great Italian food,a bar, and the most friendly staff  that I have ever experienced. This is my go to place for Pizza and wings. Outstanding. And the minute you walk in,you are welcomed. Love this place.
Ed
So good!   The chicken is amazing!  The biscuits r flaky and chicken was cooked well.  Everything taste amazing.

Place is solid AF. I give it 4 stars only due to some minor inconsistencies and bc they need to switch out those air handlers to properly cool the environment in the face of such congestion.  Every brunch item we've had has been top notch and huevos rancheros might be best in show! Lunch menu is a bit limited but who needs options when you have that Mel's chicken cutlet sandwich!  Brings me back to the inconsistency comment though, occasionally you'll get someone on the fryers who doesn't understand the concept of temperature decline with overuse and the result is an overly saturated cutlet. It's a rare occurrence but does happen there unfortunately.  The only other negative about this spot, through no fault of the restaurant, too many yentas yapping it up for an hour after the eating has finished while 100 people wait outside drenched in sweat. Another reason to upgrade the AC system folks.

Broadway Oyster Bar is a top-notch creole & cajun pub. Spicy and funky in every way (from the food to the people to the decor), BOB features live music, an eclectic and energetic ambiance, fresh oysters, unique cocktails (such as a margarita with salsa inside), and authentic NOLA cuisine. The sampler platter was a hit, with my favorite being the etouffee, if you want to pick just one. Come hungry! You're sure to have a good time.
Not all that. They were out of menu items. Not impressed at all. Chose the place cause it was close to my hotel.

This restaurant is phenomenal!! My husband and I go for our anniversary. The filet mignon, asparagus, and red wine is perfect. The cheesecake is from scratch, and so delicious. The winner is the crab cakes though, they  are truly the best, and I've tried crab cakes on the West and East Coast! I can't wait to return!

My husband and I tried to go on Tuesday 3.10.20. The restaurant wasn't busy. We walked in, and the hostess told us it would be a 15 minute wait. I said "okay" and my husband went to use the restroom, And the host just sat down in a booth, she didn't even take our name for the wait list. So rude and on purpose!
When he came back, he suggested we sit at the bar because there were many seats open, it felt weird to have to wait. We grabbed our own menus from the host stand ( the hostess was just chilling in the booth) and sat at the bar. The bartender said she would be with us in a minute. She went back and forth to the kitchen a few times but never came back to us, so we left. 
We went to a Sushi place down the street instead and had great service!
Will never try this Chili's again.

I decided to give this place a shoot on my lunch break and I'm so glad I did.  It was definitely one of the best burgers I have had. It was cooked perfectly and I loved the secret sauce. I also had the sweet potato tots and they come with a masrhmellow sauce it was very good. If you find yourself in the Tampa Soho area do yourself a favor and stop by.

This place exceeded our expectations. Came here for my husband's birthday and we were thoroughly impressed. Food and service was great. Especially the service. A must go to celebrate the milestones in life.

I don't really like to complain. I prefer to focus and rate businesses that I recommend. This particular Cracker Barrel is like a dysfunctional family thanksgiving.... you always leave feeling annoyed but keep coming back because it's "tradition."

Do you like drink refills? Nine times out of ten your cup will be empty. In a hurry? Most meals we've ordered have left us sitting (with empty glasses) for upwards of thirty to forty minutes. And let's just pray they actually got the order right. 

The food can be really good. It's why I'm giving them two stars instead of one. I've had daydreams about their cornbread muffins! Other times you can tell it's been sitting waiting for the servers to stop chatting long enough to grace us with their "rising star" presence.

Like I mentioned previously, it's a bit of a tradition to go here for my family. Maybe it's the general store and the fireplace. Maybe it's the rocking chairs and silly peg games. Maybe it's the way biscuits and gravy remind me of visits with my grandparents as a kid. But nostalgia can only take you so far. Customer service is what brings patrons back.

The wait staff makes you feel like you're an annoying distraction from their cell phones or gossip in the kitchen. That is until the bill comes and it's time to leave a tip. Then it's all smiles and small talk.

As much as it hurts my heart, I guess there are some traditions worth breaking... And better establishments to give your money to. Even other Cracker Barrels. I

So many great locations all around the New Orleans area but my favorite is Lakeview location. Amazing spot all times of the day but my personal favorite is breakfast. I suggest getting a biscuit or kolaches. Just the simple egg and cheese biscuit with bacon is a must try. Donut varieties are on a rotating schedule. Check out their social media to find out what they have in store currently. They have an awesome carry out system in place that is easy and simple to use. Lakeview location doesn't have a lot of parking in the lot but there is plenty of parking in the front or on the side streets. Order early on a Saturday as they tend to run out of items quickly!
